---
title: "fitting_empirical_data"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, tidyverse, posterior, cmdstanr, brms, bayesplot, stringr, dplyr)
```

```{r}
data <- read_delim(here("empirical/AlienData.txt"))
```


```{r}
transformed_data <- data %>% select(condition, 
                                    subject, 
                                    trial,
                                    session,
                                    cycle,
                                    category, 
                                    response,
                                    stimulus) %>%
                              filter(cycle != 0) %>% 
                              filter(condition == 1) %>% 
                              mutate(subject = ifelse(condition == 1, subject, subject + 26)) %>% 
                              mutate(stimulus = str_remove(stimulus, "\\.jpg$"),
                                     eyes = str_sub(stimulus, 1, 1),
                                     buffness = str_sub(stimulus, 2, 2),
                                     arms = str_sub(stimulus, 3, 3),
                                     spots = str_sub(stimulus, 4, 4),
                                     color = str_sub(stimulus, 5, 5)
                                    ) %>% 
                              mutate(across(c(eyes, buffness, arms, spots, color), as.numeric)) %>% 
                              select(-stimulus)
```


```{r}
stan_file <- here("pro_model.stan")

fits <- list()

test_ids <- c(unique(transformed_data$subject))

for (id in test_ids) {
 
   # Skip already fitted participants
  if (as.character(id) %in% names(fits)) {
    cat("Skipping participant", id, "(already fitted)\n")
    next
  }
  
  cat("Fitting participant", id, "\n")
  
  model <- cmdstan_model(stan_file,
                       cpp_options = list(stan_threads = FALSE),
                       stanc_options = list("O1"))
  
  participant_data <- transformed_data %>% filter(subject == id)
  
  fits[[as.character(id)]] <- model$sample(
    data = list(
      ntrials            = nrow(participant_data),
      nfeatures          = 5,
      ncategories        = 4,
      cat_true           = participant_data$category,
      y                  = participant_data$response,
      obs                = as.matrix(participant_data[, c("eyes", "buffness", "arms", "spots", "color")]),
      initial_mu         = array(0.5, dim = c(4, 5)),
      initial_sigma_diag = 1.0,
      prior_logr_mean    = log(0.2),
      prior_logr_sd      = 0.5,
      prior_logq_mean    = log(0.01),
      prior_logq_sd      = 0.5
    ),
    seed             = 123,
    chains           = 4,
    parallel_chains  = 4,
    iter_warmup      = 500,
    iter_sampling    = 1000,
    refresh          = 500,
    max_treedepth    = 10,
    adapt_delta      = 0.95
  )
}

draws_list <- lapply(fits, function(fit) as_draws_df(fit$draws()))
saveRDS(draws_list, here("empirical", "empirical_draws.rds"))
```


```{r}
# Check diagnostics immediately while temp files still exist
for (id in names(fits)) {
  diag <- fits[[id]]$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
  if (any(diag$num_divergent > 0) | any(diag$num_max_treedepth > 0)) {
    cat("\n⚠️ Issues in participant:", id, "\n")
    print(diag)
  }
}
```

```{r}
draws_list <- readRDS(here("empirical", "empirical_draws.rds"))

summaries <- list()

for (id in names(draws_list)) {
  draws <- draws_list[[id]]
  summaries[[id]] <- summarise_draws(draws, "mean", "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %>%
    filter(variable %in% c("log_r", "log_q"))
}

summary_df <- bind_rows(summaries, .id = "participant_id")

cat("\n── Empirical Summary Ranges ────────────────\n")
summary_df %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    rhat_min = min(rhat,     na.rm = TRUE),
    rhat_max = max(rhat,     na.rm = TRUE),
    ess_min  = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    ess_max  = max(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  print()
```
